normal_update_rules: classification returns the highest evidence-backed rank directly
no C-only intermediate step is required
C to A+ direct classification is valid when A+ evidence is complete
later lower-detail observation does not downgrade a higher reviewed rank
equal-rank observation preserves the reviewed rank
corrective downgrade is outside the normal classifier and requires the explicit corrective path
invalid_shape_rules: last race time without first race time is invalid
per-race rows require first and last race times
per-race rows require non-empty label and valid post time on every row
A+ requires all six approved public-safe timetable summary fields on every row
rows may classify as A when A timing fields are complete but A+ summary fields are incomplete
explicit_exclusions: no participant horse jockey trainer betting odds result payout prediction or tip fields
no source bodies or raw HTML
no promotion publication or deployment side effects
